VHist - Multiple DBL history to Table.vi

Owning Palette: History Report & Utility VIs

The VI converts multiple DBL history to 2D array of strings that can be displayed in a table. The VI returns time stamps in a separate 1D array of string that can be passed to a table header (e.g. row headers).

Click the parameters for more information

 

transpose (F). If TRUE, table data array is transposed.
time stamps. Array of timestamps for respective elements in history data.
multiple history data. Array of clusters that contains multiple history data.
history data. Array of historical values.
empty for NaN (F). If TRUE, NaN values are not shown.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
time stamp format (%c) specifies timestamp format.
data format (%.3f) specifies numeric values format.
time stamp headers returns 1D array that represents timestamps as strings in the given format.
table data returns 2D array that represents historical data as strings in the given format.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
